title: First solo at Globe Hall and roof garden
summary: Notes of what she remembers: first solo at 18 at the Old Globe Hall and playing on the roof garden, with Russell placing the locations.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Is that a list that he made out that you had?

No, no. That's just little things that I remembered about him. Oh, that's wonderful. My mother, I told him I would do that. My mother always told me that he played his first solo when he was 18 years old at the Old Globes Hall. Oh yes. I don't know where that is.
That was down by, near the auditorium. That's right. Somewhere in that section. St. Claude and St. Peter and all in there. Yeah, somewhere in that section.
And I remember him playing on a roof garden.
That's the one, the Pythian Temple, the one up by the city hall now, up in that section. That's the roof garden. Yeah.
And what else is that? All the carnival parades.
